method.aggregate: per side: median over the complete pairs of each run's reported p50 (latency), or of each run's total (full export, HTTP full sync)
method.ratio: branch / master of the two medians; per-pair branch / master is also listed

method.validation: completion markers present, zero history version and old-view mismatches, sync lines in order, no panic, fixture state per side (master hot-only, branch with cold files)
method.claims: no stability or significance verdict; medians of five values from relative A/B runs
